# Logicware LLC

> Logicware LLC is a US-registered, HIPAA-compliant dental billing company based in Wilmington, Delaware. It provides end-to-end revenue cycle management for solo dentists and small dental practices across the United States: insurance verification, claim submission, payment posting, denial management, monthly reporting, and provider credentialing.

Logicware works with general dentists, orthodontists, periodontists, endodontists, oral surgeons, and pediatric dentists who want claims submitted daily rather than batched monthly, and billing handled by specialists fluent in CDT codes and payer-specific dental rules rather than a generalist medical billing company. Every client relationship begins with a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) before any patient data is handled, and with a free, no-obligation billing audit of the practice's last 30 days of claims. There is no setup fee and no long-term contract.

Billing operations run from a remote team based in Karachi, Pakistan, working US business hours; sales and client success are based in the United States.

## Services

- [Insurance Verification](https://logicware.tech/services/insurance-verification): Verifies in-network and out-of-network benefits, annual maximums, deductibles, and frequency limits before a patient's first appointment.
- [Claim Submission](https://logicware.tech/services/claim-submission): Daily electronic claim submission via clearinghouse using the ADA Dental Claim Form, scrubbed for CDT code and attachment errors before submission.
- [Payment Posting](https://logicware.tech/services/payment-posting): EOB and ERA payment posting reconciled against contracted fee schedules, with underpayments flagged immediately.
- [Denial Management](https://logicware.tech/services/denial-management): Denied and rejected claims reviewed daily, corrected, and resubmitted within payer deadlines, with formal appeals where warranted.
- [Monthly Reporting](https://logicware.tech/services/monthly-reporting): Monthly PDF reports covering collections, denial trends, and accounts receivable aging in plain language.
- [Provider Credentialing](https://logicware.tech/services/provider-credentialing): Insurance panel credentialing and re-credentialing for a flat, transparent fee per payer.
